Keywords: Riga church Order and town jurisdiction
RagShortTexts: Riga’s church, Order and town maintain distinct claims.
Land, revenue and justice disputes require negotiation.

Variants.Content: Riga’s church, Order and town depend on one another while contesting land, revenues and justice. Ecclesiastical authority, military command and merchant rules differ. Parties and location matter; market closure or force can damage shared income.
Riga guards identify whose gate and command they serve. A cargo dispute is not automatically military business; force can enlarge a compensable quarrel.
Representatives must bind their own parties and deliver compensation. Accepting one judgment does not surrender all land or revenue rights.
Townspeople need venues for debt and damage claims. Jurisdictional delay strands goods; protection means keeping weighing, docks and deliveries working.
